status: Implemented, correctness and five full-frame pairs completed. Four candidate environments are under 10ms; mixed remains above 10ms. No all-five performance acceptance claim.
perception: One held damage card per enemy above its hull, 18px logical font, dark backplate, gold/star when the recent sum includes a critical. Individual hit history remains intact. Full mode retains type/critical groups. Actual native and GDS shield depletion impacts are visible in isolated framebuffer comparison, retain a 0.38s real flash, and expire without armor-only retrigger.
true_exits: BattleSliceRuntime.snapshot no longer traverses every projectile dictionary for actor retention, muzzle membership, or beam muzzle updates in a supported native encounter. Legacy and old-extension fallback preserved.
RetainedBeamForeground.sync and Battlefield._process beam-power cues read the ordered canonical beam subset. Ordinary projectiles no longer enter either GDScript loop.
Beam body plus its links use one MultiMesh stream per original beam; cross-beam/fallback draw order preserved.
Damage flush no longer builds whole-field obstacle occupancy or searches ten empty-space candidates per tag.

owners.combat: One SpaceCombatKernel still owns flight order/generation, actors, hits, damage, fire cadence, RNG and drops. presentation_membership/presentation_beams are const reads of typed canonical indices; no second Game or alternate combat state.
owners.beam_order: Beam indices are sorted by current canonical active_index each publication, matching full projectile array after swap compaction.
owners.geometry: Existing SimulationGeometryAuthority remains the only spatial owner. No change to entry, aiming, drone/carrier orbit, death freeze or return receipts in this presentation batch.
owners.tag: Scene owns presentation-only recent sum/card; canonical per-hit raw records are still individually retained.

validation: correctness/review.json; beam-cue-paired/comparison.json; all earlier candidates and failed fixture logs preserved. Raw sample JSON compressed losslessly, not normalized.
known_limits: Mixed final mean 10.701ms remains above 10ms. Cannon incremental gain 0.166ms does not pass a 0.5ms per-case net-gain threshold. Other four gains pass 0.5ms in this pair; repeated pairs support direction but do not establish statistical confidence.
Raw state hashes differ solely at RNG seed construction metadata; authoritative rng.state and every other canonical field match exactly before and after. Do not report raw hash equality.
The five held-health environments are synthetic checks, not the parent's independent 20-stage real play. No packaging, no main merge/push.
shield_cost: Original cannon ON/OFF diagnostic: actual two-setter CPU inclusive mean about 0.0031ms/frame. Whole ship-viewport GPU time 1.503ms ON versus 1.540ms OFF cannot isolate shield cost; no positive removable GPU gain established.
rollback: Baseline production remains reachable at 54a9fa10 (same production tree as 95737dbf). Intermediate candidates and both native builds preserved; no rollback executed.
